description:
Return the most recent predictions on the authenticated Replicate account. Useful to recover a prediction ID, audit recent calls, or check what's still running.

Args:
  - limit (1-100, default 10): How many predictions to return.

Returns structuredContent: { count: number, predictions: PredictionSummary[] }
Each PredictionSummary has id, model, status, created_at, completed_at, url.

limit.description: Number of recent predictions to return (1–100). Default 10.

name: replicate_list_predictions
title: List recent Replicate predictions
